sections.heading: Beyond aunque
sections.body:
At B2 you used *aunque, a pesar de que, por mucho que*. At C1 you add finer tools:

- *por más / mucho que* + subjunctive (however much — hypothetical or irrelevant) or indicative (real, repeated): *Por más que insistas, no voy a cambiar de opinión.*
- *por* + adjective/adverb + *que* + subjunctive (however…): *Por difícil que parezca, es posible.* (However hard it may seem…)
- *si bien* + indicative (although — formal): *Si bien el informe es completo, le faltan conclusiones.*
- *aun* + gerund (even though / even if): *Aun sabiendo la verdad, no dijo nada.* (Even knowing the truth, he said nothing.) Note: *aun* (= even) has no accent; *aún* (= still, yet) does.
- *aun cuando* (even when / even if): *Aun cuando llueva, iremos.*

sections.heading: Colloquial concessives
sections.body:
- *y eso que* + indicative (and that's even though — adds a surprising fact afterwards): *Reprobó, y eso que estudió mucho.* (He failed — even though he studied a lot.)
- *así* + subjunctive (even if — colloquial in LatAm, esp. Colombia, Mexico): *No lo hago así me paguen.* (I won't do it even if they pay me.)
- *con lo que* + indicative (considering how much): *¡Con lo que trabaja y no le suben el sueldo!* (Considering how much she works, and they don't give her a raise!)
- subjunctive reduplication: *Digas lo que digas, no te creo.* (Whatever you say, I don't believe you.) *Pase lo que pase* (whatever happens), *sea como sea* (be that as it may / one way or another), *quieras o no* (whether you like it or not).

vocab: whether you like it or not
examples: Por más que insistas, no voy a cambiar de opinión.
However much you insist, I'm not going to change my mind.
Por difícil que parezca, es posible.
However hard it may seem, it's possible.
Si bien el informe es completo, le faltan conclusiones.
Although the report is thorough, it lacks conclusions.
Aun sabiendo la verdad, no dijo nada.
Even knowing the truth, he said nothing.
Aun cuando llueva, iremos.
Even if it rains, we'll go.
Reprobó, y eso que estudió mucho.
He failed, even though he studied a lot.
No lo hago así me paguen.
I won't do it even if they pay me.
¡Con lo que trabaja y no le suben el sueldo!
Considering how much she works, and they don't give her a raise!
Digas lo que digas, no te creo.
Whatever you say, I don't believe you.
Pase lo que pase, te apoyo.
Whatever happens, I support you.
Sea como sea, hay que terminarlo hoy.
One way or another, it has to be finished today.
Quieras o no, tienes que ir.
Whether you like it or not, you have to go.
Aún no ha llegado.
He still hasn't arrived.
Por mucho que corras, no vas a llegar a tiempo.
However fast you run, you won't make it on time.
Hagas lo que hagas, hazlo bien.
Whatever you do, do it well.

exercises.prompt: *Reprobó, y eso que estudió mucho* means…
options: He failed, even though he studied a lot.
He failed, and that's why he studied.
He failed because he studied too much.
He studied a lot so he passed.

exercises.prompt: Which one means "still / yet"?
*Quieras o no* means…
options: whether you like it or not
if you want or not to go

exercises.prompt: *No lo hago así me paguen* means…
options: I won't do it even if they pay me.
I'll do it if they pay me like this.
I don't do it this way.
They paid me so I didn't do it.
